THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

This appeal is filed by the claimant challenging the judgment and award passed by the IX Additional Senior Civil Judge, Small Causes Court, Bengaluru, in MVC No.833/2010 dated 19.01.2012, for seeking enhancement of compensation.

2. Brief facts of the case are as under:
Appellant/claimant has contended that on 31.12.2008 at bout 15.40 hours claimant was proceeding as passenger in a Bus bearing Registration No.AP.02 T.2286 being driven by its driver on Peresanda-Gudibande Road with high speed in a rash and negligent manner.
When the said bus reached Ammani Bayarasagara Tank, NC: 2023:KHC:21157 driver lost control over the vehicle and bus fell into back side water of the said tank.
Appellant/claimant further contended due to terrific impact she has sustained grievous injuries.

Claimant has further contended that accident has occurred solely due to negligent driving of offended vehicle by its driver, respondent No.1 being the owner, respondent No.2 being the insurer of the offended vehicle are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation.
Hence, she prays to award compensation.

3. Heard arguments from both sides and perused the records.
4.

In the present case, the claimant is a minor girl aged 10 years old had sustained the following injuries:
1. Swelling and Tenderness over right elbow joint.

sentences.text: Lacerated wound over right forearm.
3. Head injury and other grievous injuries all over the body.
The Tribunal has granted the compensation of Rs.46,000/- which is on the lesser side.
The claimant had suffered fracture of right elbow joint and other grievous injuries.
Doctor had stated that the claimant had suffered 30% physical disability towards right hand and 12% whole body disability.
The percentage of physical disability stated by the doctor is little bit exorbitant one.
Therefore, it can be considered that the claimant had suffered physical disability towards whole body lesser to 10%.

Since the claimant is a minor girl, by following the judgment of the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of MALLIKARJUN VS. DIVISIONAL MANAGER, NATIONAL INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED AND ANOTHER reported in (2014) 14 SCC 396, the claimant is entitled to compensation under various heads as follows:
 Head Compensation  amount Pain and suffering already undergone Rs. 1,00,000/- and to be suffered in future, mental and physical shock, hardship, inconvenience, and discomforts, etc., NC: 2023:KHC:21157 and loss of amenities in life on account of permanent disability.
Discomfort, inconvenience and loss of Rs. 25,000/- earnings to the parents during the period of hospitalisation.

sentences.text: Medical and incidental expenses Rs. 25,000/- during the period of hospitalisation for 58 days Future medical expenses for Rs. 25,000/- correction of the mal union of fracture and incidental expenses for such treatment.
Therefore, the claimant is entitled to total compensation of Rs.1,75,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till realization.

7. Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed-in-part.

ii.
